key: l7r/diagram/hamletgen/homesteads/rows.py::draw_holdings#cell on a lane or stream left undrawn
fix: leaving a holding cell unplanted where a lane or stream crosses it is a decision about what was planted, not how it is shown; the claim itself says the record was searched and is silent, so it should be GUESS (or UNRESEARCHED), not CONVENTION

`MIN_WEB_GAP` (18 ft) is 0246's lane room ("a lane's room of 18 ft ... a map drawing convention"), which the bundle answers, so it is not a GUESS; it should cite 0246 §98 and note that a dispersed hamlet lays no lane (§109). For grove farms, 0036's 32 ft least gap between groves also bears on it

the amplitude matches (±RANK_DEPTH_JITTER/2 of a pitch), but the alleys-only gate rests on 0246's planned-versus-grown reading, so the claim should cite 0246 §103 for the gate and keep UNRESEARCHED for the amplitude; the ranks run only on the dispersed form, which lays no lanes

the claim's account is wrong: in the rescue only other offered seats drop to 0.3 pitch, and houses stay at 0.5 pitch in every round; this is also a candidate dedupe (the placer's envelope decides spacing), so it is closer to NONE

key: l7r/diagram/hamletgen/pondstock.py::_bank_seats#sty seat pulled in by half the bank bankinsetft so it stands
fix: sty seat pulled in by half the bank (BANK_INSET_FT) so it stands on the bank, not by the canal (0025 §259)

key: l7r/diagram/hamletgen/homesteads/rows.py::draw_holdings#holding strip cut into plots holdingcellft 150 ft deep, whic
fix: holding strip cut into plots HOLDING_CELL_FT (150 ft) deep, which 0033 §14 records as a convention

key: l7r/diagram/hamletgen/homesteads/rows.py::draw_holdings#crop cells kept back from lanes half the lane width  20 and
fix: crop cells kept back from lanes (half the lane width + 2.0) and from streams (6.0); these margins reach past the "touches" the guess claim names

the claim says every homestead stands within FORM_BOUND * the half-diagonal, but in_band is tested only at `attempt >= 4`. The rank rounds 0-3 run unbounded (no region on the dispersed form), so the claim should say the bound holds only for the front row (1.3x) and the rescue

key: l7r/diagram/hamletgen/homesteads/stages.py::_seat_households#how deep a scattered hamlet runs at most four rank rounds be
fix: how deep a scattered hamlet runs: at most four rank rounds behind the front row (range(7), attempt < 4) before the rescue
